summary.text: Robert LeVertis Bell is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing write-in Republican Lisa Holliday Harris.
He won the May 19 Democratic primary with 54.6% of the vote over Joi McAtee.

paragraphs.text: Bell defeated Joi McAtee, 2,938 votes to 2,447, in the 2026 Democratic primary for an open seat.
Ballotpedia lists his endorsements as including U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders and the Democratic Socialists of America.
